name: Paper God: Sister Smallpox at an Altar Table with Four Attendants
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink on paper; with printed title inscription reading from right to left: "Dour Jiejie" ("Sister Smallpox") and a couplet reading from right to left: "Qiancheng Gong Doujie; Ernü Bao Ankang" ("Worship Sister Smallpox; Children Will Be Healthy"). Probably from Beijing.
